description: A free sample of procurements by terms and filters, or editable suggestions by CNPJ. It does not create alerts.

cnpj.description: CNPJ to suggest up to 8 families of terms, without turning them on.

filtros.description: Extra filter: modalities, municipalities, exclusions, values, open proposals and CNAEs. PATCH replaces the whole filter; {} clears it.

abertas.description: Require the proposal deadline to be open at collection time.

cnaes.description: Up to 8 CNAE subclasses, such as 4644301 or 4644-3/01. Matches one of the purchase's three most likely CNAEs.

disputa.description: Only purchases with competitive bidding. Excludes PNCP's not-applicable bidding mode.

esferas.description: Government spheres: F federal, E state, D district and M municipal. Records without a sphere are excluded.

excluir.description: Up to 10 literal phrases, each 3–80 characters, to exclude from the purchase subject.

modalidades.description: Up to 10 PNCP procedure codes, from 1 to 19.

municipios.description: Up to 10 exact municipality names or IBGE codes. Use UF to distinguish names.

srp.description: Only purchases marked as price registration (srp) by PNCP.

valor_max.description: Maximum estimated value in Brazilian reais.

valor_min.description: Minimum estimated value in Brazilian reais.

termos.description: Object terms; a space requires all words, | accepts alternatives.
